_comment: Corrects which country a place belongs to, where the master catalogue files it under the wrong one. Keys are place names as spelled in travel_agency_dataset.json; values are the country name to assign. This exists because a cross-country package lists its whole route under each member country, so a place can end up owned by the country the traveller merely started in. Getting this wrong mis-prices visas and inter-country transport.
_kailash: The Kailash Mansarovar route crosses from Nepal into Tibet at Kerung. Everything past that point is China.
